jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(7)(I) inventory: Wolcott School District, a town school district in the Orleans Southwest Supervisory Union (member town: Wolcott). Operates K-6.

board.post_note: Wolcott SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected from the floor at the annual meeting on Town Meeting Day.

sources.note: Wolcott Town School District 2026 Annual Meeting Materials (official annual report, via OSSU): p. 2 publishes the board with term ends -- Waring 2027, Morin 2026, LaChance 2027, Davey 2026, Kaiser 2028 (board size five documented three times in the volume; the section 423(b) vote adding two seats is not itself in a fetched document); the 2026 warning (pp. 3-4) Art. 2 puts up exactly one 3-year and one 2-year seat -- the two seats expiring 2026; the certified March 4, 2025 minutes (pp. 22-24) record Davey elected 1-year, LaChance 2-year, Kaiser 3-year, matching the table. Post-election currency: the OSSU superintendent's spring 2026 newsletter lists the same five after the March 3, 2026 meeting ("everyone returned"). FLAG: which of Morin and Davey took the 3-year seat (2029) and which the 2-year (2028) is published nowhere fetched -- both are minted ELECTED with no end. Resolving document: the March 3, 2026 annual meeting minutes (to be printed in the 2027 Annual Meeting Materials).
